citations.assessment: The Bavli explicitly names Rav Yaakov bar Avuh and distinguishes the two parents and Abaye’s answers. The qualifier about the Torah scholar applies to the father.

The cited-name form has a recognizable occurrence in Ruth Rabbah 8, which gives bar Avya. The digital segment opens with Psalms in the next Ruth exposition, so the printed verse label should be retained in the English with the actual locus in this note.
The exact death-preparation interpretation is attributed to Yaakov bar Avya in Aḥa’s name. The pinned digital address is 1:9:8. Preserve Heilprin’s alternate patronymic and printed halakhah number.
